failover_plan_summary: Cross-region active-passive failover. Maintain 25% headroom in primary pool for short HA (<120s). For region outage, route to DR with warmed model cache (KV prefix caching) to avoid cold-start latency. Plan includes health-check windows and autoscale locks during failover.
sla_negotiation_points: 1) Define measurable p95/p99 on per-route basis. 2) Credits for missed latency SLOs only on 'critical' routes. 3) Maintenance windows: 6h/month allowed, with advance notice. 4) Failover RTO target: 120s for full failover; partial degrade allowed with pre-agreed throttles.
